description: Find the claims in a text and check the ones plain code can: arithmetic (PROVEN or FALSIFIED), primes, unit conversions. A famous unsolved problem (P vs NP, the Riemann hypothesis) is OPEN. Anything else is NOT CHECKED, which never means false, with a next step.

text.description: The sentence or answer to check, e.g. "2+2=5"

name: check_claim
title: Check a claim
